source_contract.status: retrospective existing-production analysis; declared before this aggregate, not before target reveal
source_contract.physical_measure: P_lambda proportional to Bernoulli(p) exp(lambda S)

controls.meaning: empirical linear source projection with intercept, refit per orientation in every aligned delete-one; not exact fixed-K or RG thermal centering

source_contract.uncertainty: pooled sample covariance with denominator samples-1, same batch omitted in both directions, retain joint output covariance and all delete-one vectors

rng_correction.actual_key: seed XOR splitmix64(N) XOR splitmix64(replica+c1) XOR splitmix64(site+c2)
rng_correction.interpretation: N is an explicit domain separator; sizes do not share the same site uniforms. Same-N orientations share all uniforms. Different N blocks are treated as independent under the ordinary domain-separated PRNG model; a shared seed/counter interval alone does not prove cross-N dependence.
rng_correction.aggregation: report both sizes and a nominal two-size joint zero statistic for the fixed raw and controlled readouts; derived views are not independent votes

limits: no E_top-times-cluster moment in this archive
N85 is not N130 or another dyadic norm4 generation
no new sample, replay, simulation, server or test suite
this is source response, not a new field count or energy identification
floating-point Gram arithmetic is not an exact rational certificate
source_contract.delivery: same Draft PR267; repository script, JSON and technical Markdown report

definitions.source: S=(CB+CW)/N is the common raw source; no geometry-adapted clock/full projection
definitions.ratio_derivatives: mu=A/Z; mu_p=(A_p-mu Z_p)/Z; mu_pp=(A_pp-mu Z_pp-2 mu_p Z_p)/Z
definitions.moment_convention: self-normalized empirical tilted moments; no ad hoc sample-covariance Bessel correction in the ratio derivatives
definitions.root: pooled q=0 within declared p_star +/- .01 with positive local slope; not a full-interval or global-unique-root proof
definitions.U: N^(13/8)/2 * P4[E_p]/mean(q_p), at the locally bracketed pooled matching root
definitions.Udot_terms: direct + rootmotion + slope_source + slope_root; all four terms share one source and full covariance
definitions.C: JE-q*(1-E)/(E-q*q)*Jq in the weighted finite three-sector marginal

thermal_clock_null: If the same-N source is common S=a+bK in both geometries, its tilt only shifts Bernoulli log-odds; refinding the matching root makes numerator and denominator Jacobians cancel, so Udot=0. The nominal joint zero statistic tests this necessary condition, not all K^2 clocks, geometry-dependent clocks, or CFT mechanisms; compatibility does not prove the affine-K model.

scoreability.scope: central and every aligned delete-one root; report failure without a substituted target

uncertainty: 100 aligned delete-one batches per N, refind pooled root in each omission, full output covariance and all vectors; N-domain-separated PRNG independence for the single nominal two-N Udot zero statistic; four additive terms are not independent evidence
estimator_boundary: Same original U definition but a different and noisier fixed-p self-normalized importance estimator, not a replacement or reproduction of threshold-histogram Rao-Blackwell results; N65/N85 alone are not the complete65-130-260 or85-170-340 norm4 lineages
source_deformation_boundary: K-binned first source moments support lambda=0 first derivatives only; exp(lambda*mean_S_given_K) is not finite-lambda configuration reweighting. No assumed q2/Jordan source-deformation law, fitted exponent, finite difference or energy identity.
